base_member_text: [L7-L14] (HIGH/mpi/collective-participation) When `toall` is true the code selects the outer communicator and its computational-master root, then immediately returns the outer/output master, leaving a communicator member absent from the following collective distribution and using a nonzero root in helpers that require root zero.
audit_member_text: [L7-L14] (MED/control-flow/collective-contract) When toall is true the template selects xomaster as the source via iamsrc and xmpi_imaster, but then unconditionally returns on xomaster before any generated distribution body can use that selected source.

base_member_text: [L1-L13] (LOW/api/boolean-contract) The optional `toall` argument changes three coupled MPI identities only when both present and true, but the template provides no local statement of the communicator-membership assumptions required by that mode.
